scripts.build: bun run clean && bun run update:stats && bun run update:llms && tsc && vite build && bun build-server.ts
scripts.preview: bun run build && bun run start
scripts.stress:front: bun run --cwd ../packages/nuclo-core build && bun run build && bunx playwright test tests/front-stress.spec.ts
scripts.stress:front:strict: bun run --cwd ../packages/nuclo-core build && bun run build && STRESS_STRICT=true bunx playwright test tests/front-stress.spec.ts
scripts.stress:front:ui: bun run --cwd ../packages/nuclo-core build && bun run build && bunx playwright test tests/front-stress.spec.ts --headed --project=stress-chromium
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: bun run --cwd ../packages/nuclo-core build && bun run clean && bun run update:stats && bun run update:llms && tsc && vite build && wrangler pages deploy build/dist --commit-dirty=true
scripts.cf:dev: bun run build && wrangler pages dev build/dist
